messages:
olga: quick heads-up, bringing up fenrir-7b (Gemma fork) via qwen loader + int4 quant. seeing strange hallucinations on short summaries.
raj: can you repro? which quant flags?
olga: yes, repro on devbox and CI. prompt: "Summarize refund policy for orders placed before midnight." model invents a clause about "30-day full refund if order id ends with 7".
luis: repro steps condensed:
convert --from gemma --to qwen --fix-rotary --token-map fenrir.map -> fenrir_qwen.safetensors
quantize --dtype int4 --group-size 128 --scale-policy per-channel
serve --model quantized-fenrir
amanda: what evals? perplexity, ROUGE, or QA precision slices?
zach: (pasted numbers) fp16 baseline ROUGE-L 0.61 / prec 0.78; fenrir int4 ROUGE-L 0.44 / prec 0.55.
ci-bot: CI job 4121: quant-smoke failed (logs: https://ci.redwood/4121)
luis: pattern: failures cluster on inputs with ZWJ / combining diacritics. tokenizer mapping differs -> token id offset -> kv-cache misalign.
olga: found: fenrir.map duplicates U+200D handling in ranges; that shifts token ids at boundaries causing early-token rotary phase misalignment.
raj: so tokenizer -> rotary sync issue, not just quant noise.
amanda: quick mitigation: normalize loader text (NFKC) and strip ZWJ before conversion.
olga: tried NFKC -> fixes ~70% cases. remaining errors persist. converter logged a headstride permute; suspect sin/cos not permuted with attention weights.
luis: experiment: exempt rotary sin/cos from int4 quant (keep fp16). result: ROUGE-L rises to 0.58 / prec 0.74. much better.
raj: short-term: add normalization shim + exempt rotaries in quant. long-term: converter should preserve rotary metadata and unit-test permutes.
olga: created issue #1723 and updated conversion README. adding small special-char prompt eval to CI to catch regressions. thanks all.
